name: Code commands
description: Slash commands for coding chats: explain, review, write tests, refactor, debug and build a regex.

commands.name: explain
commands.prompt: Explain what this code does, step by step, for someone who knows the language but not this codebase. Point out anything surprising or risky.

commands.name: review
commands.prompt: Review this change like a careful senior engineer. List real bugs first (with the line and a fix), then risky spots, then style nits last. Skip praise.

commands.name: tests
commands.prompt: Write tests for the code below using the test framework this project already uses. Cover the normal case, edge cases and failure cases. Explain any case you left out.

commands.name: refactor
commands.prompt: Refactor the code below to be easier to read and change, without changing what it does. Keep the public interface the same and explain each change in one line.

commands.name: debug
commands.description: Find the cause of an error
commands.prompt:
Help me find the cause of this error. Say what you think is happening and why, the most likely cause first, and what to check to confirm it before changing anything.

Error and what I was doing:

commands.name: regex
commands.description: Write and explain a regular expression
commands.prompt:
Write a regular expression that matches the description below. Explain each part, give three strings it matches and three it doesn't, and say which regex flavour it's for.
